summary: I tried to develop a Mars Ground Explorer, an educational interactive map combining Martian imagery, topography, geology, rover routes, and data-gap markers that I researched from the internet. It highlights five rover sites and Jezero Crater, with science cards, terrain concerns, and tools to compare routes. (I´m just a begginer at coding and did it alone so hope it  will work)
details: This project maps all the sites that were explored to this day with the informations about it. The benefit of it is that it work as an map with which ya can map the localizations and distances across it and predict the confidence if it would be go to even go there. This project was build by JavaScript with some help from my IT uncle that used somekind of Software for desing.
